profile.headline: Quantum Software Engineer
profile.summary: I'm an Experimental Physicist, Data Scientist, and Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience building data-intensive software and analytical pipelines for large-scale scientific missions. I enjoy working at the intersection of data, computation, and measurement; developing tools that transform complex datasets into meaningful scientific insight. My background combines experimental physics, statistical analysis, numerical modeling, and high-performance computing with production software engineering. Whether designing scalable Python systems, optimizing distributed workflows, or developing new algorithms, I'm motivated by solving challenging problems and using data to better understand the world around us.

positions.title: Graduate Student Researcher
positions.description:
- Particle Physics Research
- Cleaned and automated batch processing of ~100 TB size data for analysis over distributed networks.
- Developed full software framework to measure a physical process and determine the competitiveness of the measurement with statistical analysis and systematic error assessment. 
- Presented results of analytical studies at Hadronic Calibration Workshop: 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021.
- Supervisor: Professor Francois Corriveau corriveau@physics.mcgill.ca

positions.title: Equity Diversity Inclusion Co-coordinator
positions.description:
- Fostered anti-racist awareness and education within the department and the community by coordinating meetings and organizing events. 
- Partnered with 500+ professors, students, and employees to develop and implement an action plan.
- Professional Contact: Dr. Eve Lee, evelee@physics.mcgill.ca

positions.title: Teaching Assistant (TA)
positions.description:
- As a TA for undergraduate physics courses, taught experimental methods, signal processing, and data analysis. 
- Created problem sets and exams for electromagnetism and optics for 200+ undergraduate students.
- Professional Contact: Dr. Michael Hilke, michael.hilke@mcgill.ca

positions.title: Physics Open Source databse developer
positions.description:
- Designed an open-source database using MySQL for physics problems aligned with the Open-Stax physics textbook.
- Professional Contact: Dr. Mark Slovak, mslovak@hawaii.edu

positions.title: Summer Research Algorithms
positions.description:
-  Optimized processing ability to detect near-Earth objects and asteroids by developing algorithms using 3D range trees.
- Professional contact: Dr. Nodari Sitchinava, nodari@hawaii.edu, https://algoparc.ics.hawaii.edu/

positions.title: Laboratory Technician
positions.description:
- Quantified characteristics of materials to detect single photons. Communication through data visualization, plots, and conference presentations: CUWIP 2017 (Conference for Undergraduate Women in Physics).
- Professional Contact: Dr. Radovan Milincic, milincic@hawaii.edu
